reason: I use AI all day at work, but I'm not letting an agent invest and pay for things with my actual money, and a cartoon pet running it makes it feel even less serious. My robo-adviser already does the boring rebalancing without me having to trust a chatbot.
objection: An AI moving real money on its own is exactly the thing I don't want. Limits and a kill switch are nice, but I'd still be wondering what it did while I wasn't looking, and the Tamagotchi doesn't make it feel any safer.
would_change_my_mind: A long, public track record on real money with a named, licensed broker holding the account and insuring it, with no surprise trades, before I'd even consider it.
